literal_meaning: অবশিষ্টাংশ বা ফেলে দেওয়া জিনিস থেকে জীবিকা
figurative_meaning_en: Trivial or lowly livelihood; living on meager income
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উঞ্ছবৃত্তি করে দিন কাটে, কোনো স্থায়ী আয় নেই।
গ্রামে অনেকেই উঞ্ছবৃত্তি করে সংসার চালান।
example_sentences_in_english: He scrapes by on a meager livelihood with no steady income.
Many in the village sustain their families through menial occupations.
history: Derived from ancient Indian traditions where ascetics or mendicants lived on scraps or alms, reflecting a life of renunciation and simplicity.
note: Often used in literary contexts to describe economic hardship rooted in cultural norms of austerity.
